admission.justification: The text and list branches can independently conceal a structural edit: stripped token boundaries can be called whitespace, while unbounded/unequal list correspondence can invent a pair. Both guards must hold for this bounded wording-presentation obligation, and their source/proof facets name the distinct cases. Existing reading-place and comparison-inspection family guarantees do not express this combined alignment safety; no existing family is broadened.

guarantee: For supplied intent wording, text classification does not hide a changed non-whitespace token boundary as whitespace-only, and list alignment does not guess pairs beyond its whole-list cell rail or across unequal remaining gaps. The list branch retains the ordered supplied items and explicit cell_limit/unpaired_gap reasons rather than manufacturing pair identity. Together these guard both text and list presentations against unsupported unchanged/pairing appearances; neither member alone does. This is classification/alignment structure, not semantic approval, original-file byte authentication or a measured whole-view/runtime budget.
title: Bounded token-faithful intent wording
